                        From the Principal’s Desk




 Dear Students, Faculty Members of the Bahona College Community
I am delighted to share an exciting development in our academic offerings at Bahona
College. Beginning with the academic session 2024-25, we are proud to introduce the
Integrated Teacher Education Program (ITEP) B.A./B.Sc. B.Ed. courses. Through
ITEP, we are introducing dual-major programs in Arts and Science (B.A. B.Ed. and
B.Sc. B.Ed.). These programs have been meticulously designed to align with the vision
of National Education Policy-2020 and to meet the growing demand for skilled and
knowledgeable educators.
 The ITEP is a comprehensive four-year program aimed at preparing future educators
with a solid foundation in both subject knowledge and pedagogical skills. This
integrated approach ensures that our graduates are not only proficient in their chosen
subjects but are also equipped with the necessary teaching methodologies to excel in
diverse educational environments.
   I am happy that our Prospectus committee has brought out a new edition of the
college prospectus for Four Year Integrated B.Ed. Course. I congratulate the team
behind this effort and wish them a fulfilling year ahead.
Thank you
                                                                Dr. Sumbit Chaliha
                                                            Principal, Bahona College

                               From the HoD’s Desk




Message from Head of the Department:
Greetings from Bahoana College!
It gives me immense pleasure to welcome you all to 4 year Integrated Teacher Education
Programme (ITEP) which is starting from this year onward. At present, teacher education
scenario has witnessed a significant change in its structure and its process. As per the guidelines of
NEP -2020, 4 year Integrated Teacher Education programme is introduced all over India. NCTE
has granted recognition to 64 no. Higher Institutions for ITEP forthe academic year 2024-25.
Bahona College in association with Post Graduate Training College ( IASE), Jorhat got
recognition from NCTE for starting B.A. B.Ed ( Secondary), B.Sc .B.Ed ( Secondary), B.A. B.Ed
( Middle ) and B.Sc .B.Ed ( Middle ) from 2024-25 onward.
The 4 year integrated B.Ed is designed for holistic development of students. We ensure to develop
future teachers who will be academically sound, psychologically strong, technologically advanced
and professionally ethical. We will provide a cheerful, productive and learned experience to our
students to explore the real world. Our well qualified staff, modern amenities, psychological
laboratory, ICT laboratory, well equipped library will help tremendously to walk confidently in
the path of teaching profession. Along with academic growth we will imbibe moral human values in
students that will result in producing excellent citizens of the country.
Your future is protected here and we will give you safe and healthy atmosphere. I warmly greet all
learners to our institution.
                                                                                 Unfeignedly,
                                                                            Dr. Rashmi Rekha Devi
                                                                                   HoD

                         About Collaborative College
  Post Graduate Training College was started in 1957. In the last few decades of Post
  Graduate    Training    College,   the   secondary    school    teachers   and   educational
  administrators were deputed to the college from different Government Schools of Assam.
  The deputed teachers considered it a rare opportunity to join Post Graduate Training
  College as student- teachers where they could enjoy a rich blend of cultures. The friendly
  and cordial relationship between the teachers and teacher educators added grandeur to it.
  They worked together not only during the class hours but afterwards also by taking part
  in games and sports, music, dramatization along with academic discussion. The student
  teachers are mostly deputed by the Govt. of Assam. A few seats are open for pre-service
  students also. At present a combined entrance test is held by the Dibrugarh University to
  select prospective student on merit cum performance in the common Entrance Test.
  We, at Post Garduate Tranning College (IASE), ensure high quality education, which
  motivates and empowers our students to be lifelong learners and productive members of
  the society. As per the guideline of NEP 2020 we are looking forward to introduce 4 year
  Integrated Teacher Education Programme (ITEP). The programme aims at preparing
  teachers for foundational, preparatory. Middle and Secondary stages as per the new
  school structure of NEP 2020. It will encourage students to enter into teaching
  profession from multiple disciplines and understand the pedagogy of teaching from broad
  aspects.
  We are really delighted to sign our M.O.U with Bahona College, Jorhat to start
  Integrated Teacher Education Programme (TEP) in a multidisciplinary environment. We
  both the colleges will try our level best to provide quality education to our students in best
  possible way. This course caters to the need of 21 Century skills. We look forwarded to
  welcome you to be part of our vibrant learning community.


                                                   Prof. Tridib Bordoloi. Principal i/c
                                                     PGTC (IASE) Jorhat, Assam

                     About the ITEP Programme
  Bahona College offers the 4-year Integrated Teacher Education programme (ITEP) B.A.
  B.Ed/B.Sc. B.Ed (Middle & Secondary Level), a dual major undergraduate degree, from the
  academic year 2024-25. The Four Year ITEP is a milestone achievement in fulfilling one of
  the major mandates of National Education Policy 2020. The ITEP aims at the dual purpose of
  providing student teachers disciplinary knowledge along with the professional knowledge in an
  integrated manner. The program will be equivalent to an Undergraduate Degree (B.Sc./B.A.)
  and Teacher Education Degree. The curriculum of this program includes different courses and
  activities essential for both the degrees.
  ITEP will be in multi and interdisciplinary academic environment and shall be implemented as
  per the guidelines of the NCTE and affiliating university. This program will prepare teachers
  for the new curricular and pedagogical structure of school education as reconfigured, to make
  it responsive and relevant to the developmental needs and interests of learners at different
  stages of their development, corresponding to the stages like Fundamental, Preparatory,
  Middle and Secondary guided by the 5+3+3+4 design. The ITEP will help all students who
  choose teaching as a profession after secondary, by choice. This integrated course will be
  beneficial for the students as they will save 1 year by completing this course in 4 years against
  the normal duration of 5 years as in the case of the existing B.Ed. programme. The
  programme has been permitted to share the existing physical resources of other departments of
  Bahona College
  The course will contribute substantially to the revitalization of the whole teacher education
  sector. The prospective teachers passing out of this course through a multidisciplinary
  environment, reinvented Indian values and traditions will be instilled with the needs of 21st
  century on global standards. Hence, it will be largely helpful in shaping the future of Modern
  India.

      Admission Guidelines of ITEP, B.A./B.Sc.B.Ed
              (Middle & Secondary level)

      ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:


        Candidates with minimum 50% marks in Senior Secondary or plus two

    examination or its equivalent (under 5+3+3+4 pattern) from a recognized

    board are eligible for Entrance Examination.

         The relaxation in the reservation for Scheduled Caste or Scheduled

    Tribe or Other Backward Class or Persons with Disabilities or

    Economically Weaker Section and any other categories shall be as per the

    rules of the State Government.

        A single nation-wide entrance test called National Common Entrance

    Test (hereinafter referred to as ‘NCET’) will be conducted by NTA for

    admission to the 4 Year ITEP under the recommendations of NEP 2020.

       The mode of examination (NCET) shall be online/Computer Based Test

    (hereinafter referred to as ‘CBT’) in multilingual pattern and its score

    would reflect the relative performance level of the candidate for merit-based

    selection to secure the admission. Scorecard shall be prepared by NTA and

    admission shall be done through centralized online counseling.

     ADMISSION PROCESS:


        Only candidates who have qualified the National Common Entrance

    Test are eligible to apply for admission.

         Admission will be conducted through Samarth Portal as accordance

    with the guidelines of the NCTE

       At the time of admission to the programme, the candidate must indicate

    the subjects/discipline (B.A. B.Ed./B.Sc. B.Ed.).

        The merit list will be published on both the Samarth Portal and the

    College Website.

          Selected candidates must attend the college for verification and

    admission on the notified date.
